component: DAV privilege classification and provider test coverage

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The refresh predicate drops write-properties and adds bind while preserving an already read-only calendar. Both test variants return three explicit privilege sets from the fake server and assert the resulting readOnly Boolean after onLoad. They directly cover cached and uncached CalDAV refresh, not the two discovery methods or a live invitation write. The new assertion messages state the expected writable/read-only result. No test ran.
title: CalDAV privilege tests assert read-only results for cached and uncached calendars
